assumptions.proposition: The patient has acute pancreatitis as the cause of his current severe epigastric abdominal pain and elevated lipase.
evidence: Labs were notable for: lipase- 1120
He describes the pain as both burning and stabbing, epigastric in  location and radiating to the back.

assumptions.proposition: The patient has a known well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumor involving the pancreatic head/pancreaticoduodenal groove with regional necrotic lymph node metastases.
evidence: Biopsies and brushings were taken, which showed a well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumor.

A CT abdomen was then performed on ___ which showed a 3.6 cm ill-defined arterially hypo-enhancing lesion at the pancreaticoduodenal groove concerning for cancer. There was note made also of lymph node involvement including a 5-cm necrotic common hepatic lymph node.

assumptions.proposition: The pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor and nodal disease are locally advanced with mass effect on major vascular structures and the biliary tree, influencing both staging and the mechanism of his pancreatitis.
evidence: The lesion itself has a mass effect on the IVC and the nodal conglomerate in case of the main portal vein and abuts the common hepatic artery, the origin of the gastroduodenal artery and the proximal hepatic artery.
The main portal vein is compressed between the lobulated components of the mass/lymphadenopathy and remains moderately attenuated

assumptions.proposition: There is concern for ongoing or recurrent obstruction or other hepatobiliary complication despite improved LFTs, in the setting of a CBD stent and prior obstructive jaundice.
evidence: He was found to have pancreatic mass and LFTs suggestive of biliary obstruction (Tbili 6.3) and underwent ERCP with biopsy and biliary stent placement.
RUQ ultrasound showed CBD dilation at the porta hepatis similar to prior, 3.4 cm necrotic lymph node.

assumptions.proposition: Existing cross-sectional imaging is either dated relative to this acute episode or technically limited, so current pancreatic inflammation, complications, and precise tumor extent may not be fully characterized.
evidence: A CT abdomen was then performed on ___ which showed a 3.6 cm ill-defined arterially hypo-enhancing lesion at the pancreaticoduodenal groove concerning for cancer.
This study is moderately limited by patient inability to hold breath, and respiratory motion artifact.
